# Istiyaq Khan Razin — Personal Blog

> The personal technical blog of Istiyaq Khan Razin. Exploring AI workflow automation, content systems engineering, Python scripting, n8n orchestration, and building autonomous tools for creators and developers.

## Core Topics & Technical Focus Areas

- **AI Workflow Automation**: Building autonomous agentic pipelines, LLM-powered content systems, and automated production workflows.
- **n8n Orchestration & Integration**: Designing webhook architectures, multi-app workflows, error handling, and self-hosted automation infrastructure.
- **Python Systems & Scripting**: Production scripts, data transformation pipelines, API clients, and creator engineering tools.
- **Creator Engineering & Tooling**: System architecture for scaling content production, research synthesis, batch publishing, and distribution analytics.
- **Full-Stack Engineering**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB database architecture.

## Major Sections & Key URLs

- [Home](https://blog.istiyaq.com/): Primary portal, featured highlights, systems philosophy, and selected projects.
- [Articles & Blog](https://blog.istiyaq.com/blog): Complete archive of technical write-ups, tutorials, and workflow guides.
- [Privacy Policy](https://blog.istiyaq.com/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling practices.
- [XML Sitemap](https://blog.istiyaq.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML index of all published blog posts and public pages.
- [Portfolio & Main Site](https://istiyaq.com): Istiyaq Khan's central portfolio and contact hub.
